candidates.title: Send an event-triggered email alert

demandEvidence.chore: Build a workflow that sends an email notification when a specific event occurs.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’m building an n8n workflow that sends an email notification when a specific event occurs.

ease.reason: A beginner can test notification wording with operator-supplied sample events, but no supplied reference supports SMTP setup or delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: professional service teams might pay for event email setup; this single post proves no buyer intent or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can map a sample event to a notification; connecting an SMTP provider and handling failures remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed loop could format an event notification, but no source supports a trigger or delivery; a person must verify and send.

evidence.reason: The post explicitly describes an event-triggered email notification, but gives no event details, recurrence, constraints, or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: A synthetic event-to-email prototype is concrete, but all five provisional scores average below 6 because trigger details and implementation support are absent.
